analysis.purpose: cmdInstallHooks implements the `crib install-hooks` CLI command. It resolves the repository root, installs knowledge-crib git hooks via installHooks, and prints a summary of the installed post-commit hook, .gitattributes entry, and merge driver configuration.
responsibilities: Resolve the repository root from cwdOverride, path argument, or current directory
Install git hooks and merge driver configuration via installHooks
Print a summary of installed hook paths and merge driver config

businessRules.rule: Hook installation targets the resolved repository root
businessRules.rationale: repoRoot is resolved from ctx?.cwdOverride ?? pathArg(args) ?? '.' and passed to installHooks

sideEffects: Modifies the target repository's .git directory by installing hooks
May modify or create .gitattributes and git config entries
errorBehavior: No local error handling shown; failures from installHooks or path resolution would propagate
invariants: The printed summary references exactly the paths returned by installHooks
preconditions: The target path must be a git repository or installHooks must be able to initialize git hooks there
postconditions: Git hooks and merge driver are installed and a summary is printed
risks: Unresolved path.resolve call means exact resolution semantics are not modeled
No validation that the target is actually a git repository before installing hooks
whatToDistrust: installHooks internals are not validated in this seed
